opening.argument: The presentation promotes StrongBlock nodes as daily passive income while requiring viewers to acquire 10 STRONG tokens before opening a node and collecting rewards. It connects those returns to wallet funding, transaction approvals, gas charges, and a recurring maintenance fee, then projects earnings from multiple nodes. That combination supports finding a paid-node scam promotion: viewers are directed to commit funds and pay ongoing costs to pursue advertised returns. Rewards are expressly not guaranteed, and the speaker advises due diligence, but those qualifications do not remove the central paid-return pitch.
